Cost: 50eb (Costly) for a box of 10 Dual-Casings

Cost: 250eb (Premium) for a box of 10 Tri-Casings

“Trauma get all the best kit. I’ve seen two of ‘em packing G-58’s unload explosive-AP smart-gyros on a pack of Tygers. Damn cats didn’t last 10 seconds. And if you buy a box of these, you can make ‘em yourself.”

These adapter casings can be used to combine multiple different types of arrow, bullet, shell, or slug into a single round that has the effects of all merged ammunition types. If any of the combined ammunition types cause the attack to not deal damage, then the attack does not deal damage regardless of what other types are combined. All other effects still occur, if they do not require damage to do so.

A box of Combo Casings comes with either 10 Dual-Casings or 10 Tri-Casings. Dual-Casings can combine up to two ammunition types, and Tri-Casings can combine up to three ammunition types. Creating 10 combined rounds can be done as a single Action with a jig included in every box. When done by hand, loading a single round into an adapter casing takes an Action. Combo Casings are not reusable.

When firing Dual-Casing or Tri-Casing ammunition, the weapon's quality is considered one quality tier lower to a minimum of Poor Quality (e.g., Excellent to Standard, Standard to Poor, Poor to Non-Functional [i.e., PQ Weapons are considered Destroyed after firing, but not beyond Repair]). Attachments that increase a weapon’s quality (e.g., Foregrips and Laser Sights) still do so when firing Dual/Tri-Casing ammunition, they just treat the weapon’s base quality as one tier lower.

Stack: 10

Foundry notes:

  • Not loadable ammo: an adapter you apply to other rounds or grenades.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
